title: Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.06206v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture of experts has emerged as the primary mechanism for making Large Language Models (LLMs) computationally efficient. However, in distributed settings, communicating token embeddings between experts is a significant bottleneck. We present the novel Federation of Experts (FoE) architecture. FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts. Between clusters, a sum synchronizes the post-attention residuals, which then drives routing and dispatch for the next MoE block. In a single-node setting, FoE completely eliminates all-to-all communication as all experts within a group are contained on the same GPU. In multi-node settings, FoE confines all-to-all communication to the intra-node fabric, thus significantly reducing communication overhead. An implementation of FoE finds that on LongBenc

translated_title: 专家联邦：面向大语言模型的高效通信分布式推理
translated_abstract: 专家混合已成为使大语言模型（LLM）在计算上高效的主要机制。然而，在分布式场景下，专家之间传输词元嵌入是一个显著的瓶颈。我们提出了新颖的专家联邦架构。FoE将Transformer层的MoE模块重构为多个MoE集群，每个集群仅负责一个KV头，并在这些专家之间应用专家并行。在集群之间，通过求和操作同步注意力后的残差，该残差随后驱动下一个MoE模块的路由与分发。在单节点设置中，由于一个组内的所有专家都位于同一GPU上，FoE完全消除了all-to-all通信。在多节点设置中，FoE将all-to-all通信限制在节点内部互连结构中，从而显著降低了通信开销。对FoE的实现测试发现，在LongBenc（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出专家联邦架构，通过将MoE模块重构为仅负责单个KV头的多个集群，在单节点场景下完全消除、在多节点场景下将all-to-all通信限制在节点内部，从而大幅降低大语言模型分布式推理的通信开销。
